name: Transport-rule metadata (selected rules or inventory)
description: Bounded metadata with original rule GUIDs and explicit selected/inventory scope. Unknown values and saturated reads stay incomplete; no rule content or changes.

parameters.name: RuleGuids
parameters.label: Exchange rule GUIDs
parameters.help: Optional one to50 exact rule GUIDs. Leave blank only when explicitly selecting organisation inventory.

parameters.name: OrganisationInventory
parameters.label: Read bounded organisation inventory
parameters.help: Explicitly read visible rule metadata instead of selected GUIDs; this does not prove complete effective mail flow.

prerequisites: Approved installed ExchangeOnlineManagement and an Exchange role permitting transport-rule reads. Live module/RBAC remains unverified; no installation or fallback is offered.
limitations: Metadata only: no predicates/actions/content, effective security or change authority.
Exactly one scope: selected rule GUIDs or explicit organisation inventory.
Total5000 rows including diagnostics; saturation remains Partial, never complete inventory.
Original service GUIDs differ from local scope hashes. Source and live/RBAC behaviour remain unverified.
